requirements:
github_org_control==1.0.0
git+https://github.com/fastai/ghapi.git@master
ldap3==2.9.1
jsonschema==4.4.0
PyGithub==1.55
PyYAML==6.0
requests==2.27.1
dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "-c", "print('OpenVINO DevOps container ready')"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt includes pinned versions for stability (requests, ldap3, jsonschema, PyGithub, PyYAML) and direct GitHub install for ghapi. Empty string import ignored. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs requirements, copies code, and sets a default startup message. Assumes DevOps scripts are in current directory.
